items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I was playing with Dave who’d played with all my heroes, you know, Elvin Jones, Miles Davis

ctx.x: Well what was the first big gig for you?

Well the first band that I really worked in I played with, I did a tour with John Scofield in 1978 that was my first European tour, and that was a tour. And then I was working with Dave Liebman in ’78. And that was a very, very nurturing experience for me. I was the young blood and I was playing with Dave who’d played with all my heroes, you know, Elvin Jones, Miles Davis and that band also included a fantastic trumpet player from Japan, Terumasa Hino, John Scofield was in that band and eventually it was Ron…

Yeah, I think a work in progress. I think when I started playing with really great world class musicians who I admired and it worked out between us and I got encouragement from them. You know, which is kind of what you’re saying. Steve Grossman, an amazing tenor player, and I’m just thinking about people early on, and Joe Chambers, a very respected drummer/composer and when I was working with Jeremy Steig’s band, this was like 20 years ago, and Eddie Gomez playing bass, and these people and they would compliment…

items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He took a lesson but I didn’t teach him.

ctx.x: There’s a lot of guys. I used to teach down at Frank Ippolito, upstairs there. Frank was teaching there and Norman Grossman from Manus College. The three of us, we had these kids, these students coming in. So I ran into one of my students who lives in California, out in Los Angeles. Every time we play at the Jazz Bakery he comes in. He brought all of his kids, his son! Big boys! They’re grown up now. He’s got dozens of students and he always comes by to say hello. He always comes to see me. Ken Kimery: Did you…
He took a lesson but I didn’t teach him. Adam Nussbaum was curious but I didn’t think he was serious.
What’s that students name out in Los Angeles?
